info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Business Analysi Branch Portfolio-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of business analysis branch portfolios, enabling financial institutions to better manage and assess their branch performance. Users can submit detailed data regarding their branch performance metrics, helping them to make informed decisions based on comprehensive analysis. The API caters primarily to banking professionals and analysts who need to generate and maintain portfolios for strategic planning or profitability assessments. Through seamless integration, organizations can optimize their operational efficiency in evaluating branch contributions.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new branch portfolio based on specified business analysis parameters. It enables the organization to effectively manage and analyze different branch strategies for optimal performance.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit data for analyzing the branch portfolio. It contains necessary information required by the system to process the business analysis and return insights on portfolio performance.
